decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Plant Noise Assessment (11329/005mb-RevA), received 6 December 2011, P200, PE201, PE202, PE203, PE10R, P201, P202, P203, P300, P10R, Received 13 October 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 3 - The rating level of any noise generated by plant and equipment as part of the development shall be at least 10dB below the pre-existing background noise level as determined by BS4142: 1997 - Method of rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas, as detailed within the Plant Noise Assessment (11329/005mb-RevA) by Applied Acoustic Design, received 6 December 2011.
description: Installation of eleven  new condenser units, diesel tank enclosure, two extract fans, one air handling unit within existing base building plant area on roof level
